text:
Avery: Opening this follow-up thread for the leadership Q&A we ran in the all-hands. Post short clarifying questions about mission, market positioning, or competitor messaging and well answer.
Noah: Quick: when pitching to platform teams, do we open with "unified runtime" or "cost controls and SLOs"? which resonates more?
Camille: For platform folks lead with "unified runtime + observability" then call out cost controls. Platform teams care about standardization and debugging first.
Diego: For customer objections about "model lock-in", what's the simplest rebuttal?
Avery: Say: "Redwood is model-agnostic and supports pinned versions and verified performance profiles; we help you migrate models without redoing your infra." Keeps it short.
Harper: Competitor callouts: can we name specific vendors in RFPs? Legal recently warned us about public claims.
Avery: You can name competitors in private RFP responses if you stick to verifiable facts. Avoid comparative superlatives in public marketing unless sourced.
Noah: Are there any new slides or one-pagers we should reference when talking about Dedicated vs Private?
RudderBot: One-pager links posted to the sales drive: https://drive.example.com/redwood/dedicated-vs-private (AE kit folder).
Camille: Message nuance: hosted API = fast time-to-value; Dedicated = committed capacity + SLA; Private = full control + compliance. Keep those bullets consistent across decks.
Diego: Roadmap nuance: if asked about upcoming latency improvements, is it okay to say "ongoing kernel optimizations" or should we give a quarter?
Avery: "Ongoing kernel and caching optimizations" is fine publicly. For customers under NDA give timelines.
Harper: One last ask 646: can leadership drop a one-line elevator pitch we can paste in outreach?
Avery: Use: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical so engineering teams can ship LLM features with confidence." Short and copy-ready.
Noah: Thanks 44d. If someone posts benchmarking numbers can we get a citation we can include in public slides?
RudderBot: Benchmark citation: internal perf deck (slides 15-17) and sanitized numbers in the AE public branch: https://git.example.com/redwood/perf-suites/tree/public-ae-quick
Avery: Thanks everyone. Ill collate a short bulleted summary and drop it here before COB. Tag me for urgent clarifications. :sparkles:
